entries.description: Identified that the TT template's GitHub Action is a free placed-and-routed oracle, and ruled that the tapeout pre-registration is written BEFORE the first harden run — including bring-up acceptance nine months before chips exist.

Left N (the tile count) and the tile geometry as BLANKS with a source field, refusing to supply either from memory, and declared the bar UNARMED until they are filled from the specs page. A guessed threshold decides cases it was never shown, and this one is an input to a 70-euro decision.
entries.artifact_link: TAPEOUT_PREREGISTRATION.md — the one constant this file does not have

entries.description: Pre-registered BOTH a bit-exactness bar and a physics-residual gate for bring-up, not one. Either alone has failed in this project before: RTL and golden once agreed for three rounds on a sign-inverted gain, and a physics check once passed on a value quantised to junk.

Declined to pre-register bars for power, on-die area vs estimate, and yield. Those are measurements to take, not thresholds to clear; inventing thresholds with no basis would be the guessed-threshold defect wearing a rigour costume.

Caught that N was filed as a FACT when it is a fact times a DECISION — tile geometry is read, but the tile count is a budget ceiling constrained by the shapes sold. A decision misfiled as a transcription is the provenance blur the void conditions exist to prevent. Also supplied the readings and pinned the clock to a number rather than the phrase 'the shuttle clock'.

Required STEP ZERO for bring-up: the harness must pass its full four-row acceptance against known-good hardware BEFORE any die verdict. In May 2027 a FAIL is otherwise ambiguous between a bad die and bad glue — the exact ambiguity that cost four kills and a morning in the lean4lean incident. The step-1b positive-control rule, applied to a test rig nine months early.

Added the mirror to step zero unprompted: the harness must also be shown to FAIL on an injected one-LSB error. A control that only acquits is half a control, and a harness that passes everything is indistinguishable from one that is not connected.

Flagged that the prediction's upper bound (8 tiles) EQUALS the bar (N=8), so a result of exactly 8 passes by zero margin. Written into the file because this project has been burned twice this week by results landing exactly on a bar — W=12 at exactly three octaves, W=16 at almost exactly the 4-tile line.
